longDescription:
## What it is

Apache Solr is the original open source search server built on Apache Lucene. Battle-tested since 2004, used by Netflix, Apple, eBay, and many others. Full-text search, faceted search, geospatial, ML model upload, vector search (recent versions).

## Why we recommend it

If you need the most battle-tested open source search, Solr is it. The codebase has been around for 20 years and is incredibly mature. The performance is excellent at scale.

## When to use it

- Enterprise search with battle-tested stack
- E-commerce product search with faceting
- Search for large document collections
- When Elasticsearch is too heavy
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name solr -p 8983:8983 solr:solr
```

**Admin UI:** http://localhost:8983/solr
pricingDetails: Free. Apache-2.0 licensed. Self-host on JVM.
